in_sanskrit.name: Bipul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Two steps, advance
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bipul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bipul is derived from Sanskrit words 'bi' meaning 'two' and 'pula' meaning 'steps'. This name signifies taking two steps towards advancement or progress. It is a powerful name for a baby boy.
